objectives_fil: Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag.
objectives_en: Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kaso: Nadapa ang siklista at masakit at deformed ang braso
sections.takeaway_en: Case: A cyclist fell and now has a painful, deformed forearm

sections.takeaway_fil: Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag.
sections.takeaway_en: Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.

sections.takeaway_fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong.

check.prompt_fil: Sa kasong ito, ano ang unang tugon?
check.prompt_en: In this case, what comes first?

options.fil: Maghintay muna at huwag ipaalam sa staff.
options.en: Wait without notifying the responsible staff.

options.fil: Gawin muna ang shortcut kahit walang kumpirmasyon.
options.en: Use the shortcut before confirming the facts.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Unahin ang kaligtasan at agarang tulong. 2: Maaaring maantala ang kinakailangang assessment. 3: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag ituwid, imasahe, lagyan ng di-angkop na splint, o ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury maliban kung kailangan sa kaligtasan.
check.feedback_en: 1: Prioritize safety and timely help. 2: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 3: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not straighten a deformity, massage it, use an unpadded improvised splint without training, or move a person with possible spinal injury unless safety demands it.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gumamit ng props para ipakita ang suporta sa posisyon, ipaliwanag ang panganib ng paggalaw at tumawag.
sections.takeaway_en: Use a prop to show support in place, explain when movement is unsafe and make the referral call.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral.
sections.takeaway_en: Observe the task and appropriate referral.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag ituwid, imasahe, lagyan ng di-angkop na splint, o ilipat ang posibleng may spinal injury maliban kung kailangan sa kaligtasan. 2: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 3: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
check.feedback_en: 1: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not straighten a deformity, massage it, use an unpadded improvised splint without training, or move a person with possible spinal injury unless safety demands it. 2: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 3: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
